Major changes to Annex A were made as follows:
- Part 9-1: the temperature limits for selected material types were changed.
- Part 9-2: the permissible noise level at corridors was increased.
- Part 9-3: the required displacement was reduced.
- Part 9-4: the multiplied energy is now normalized on the factor 2.
- Part 9-5: the performance category of the housing assembly for windows was changed from Category "A" to Category "B".
- Part 9-6: no new information was added.
- In particular, Category "D" has been abolished completely.
- The information maximum value for sound power (SPL) has been left unchanged.

The basic principles of a new EN standard for acoustic comfort for buildings (CEN/EN 1628-1 (2008-11)) "Standard EN 1628-1:2008: Determination of acoustic comfort for buildings" is available on the web. This standard will replace all other national standards in Europe.

**CEN/TC148** is preparing the acoustics part of the standard. Its next work group (WG12) is preparing three multidisciplinary sub-groups:
- Monitoring and characterization of the acoustic environment in buildings,
- Modeling of acoustic situation in buildings, and
- Assessment of acoustic comfort. WG12 is preparing a draft CEN/TC148 draft recommendation for the next meeting.
In addition, a working group of WG12 On behalf of the CEN/TC148 working group on "Climate change" the first meeting of the working group was held in October 2022.

The ISO 11363 standard for measurement of sound pressure levels under stepped conditions (ISO 11363-2:2021) was developed and implemented in CEN/TC117 in 2017. In December 2020, a working group of CEN/TC117 started developing the standard. The next meeting of the group will be in October 2022.

More information on acoustics for the CEN/TC117 task group Acoustics.

CEN/EN 1628-4 Chart 10 Energy Band CEN/TC148 Working Group on "Acoustics" was omitted from the "2021-2024 Technical Report Wuensch et al."

The ISO 11363 standard for measurement of sound pressure levels under stepped conditions (ISO 11363-2:2021) was developed and implemented in CEN/TC117 in 2017. In December 2020, a working group of CEN/TC117 started developing the standard. The next meeting of the group will be in October 2022.

Major changes to Annex A were made as follows:

- Part 9-1: the temperature limits for selected material types were changed.
- Part 9-2: the permissible noise level at corridors was increased.
- Part 9-3: the required displacement was reduced.
- Part 9-4: the multiplied energy is now normalized on the factor 2.
- Part 9-5: the performance category of the housing assembly for windows was changed from Category "A" to Category "B".
- Part 9-6: no new information was added.

The basic principles of a new EN standard for acoustic comfort for buildings (CEN/EN 1628-1 (2008-11)) "Standard EN 1628-1:2008: Determination of acoustic comfort for buildings" is available on the web. This standard will replace all other national standards in Europe.

**CEN/TC148** is preparing the acoustics part of the standard. Its next work group (WG12) is preparing three multidisciplinary sub-groups:
- Monitoring and characterization of the acoustic environment in buildings,
- Modeling of acoustic situation in buildings, and
- Assessment of acoustic comfort. WG12 is preparing a draft CEN/TC148 draft recommendation for the next meeting.

In addition, a working group of WG12 On behalf of the CEN/TC148 working group on "Climate change" the first meeting of the working group was held in October 2022.

European foreword

The text of document 22G/522A/CDV, future edition 2 of IEC 61800-9-2/AMD1, prepared by SC 22G "Adjustable speed electric power drive systems (PDS)" of IEC/TC 22 "Power electronic systems and equipment" was submitted to the IEC-CENELEC parallel vote and approved by CENELEC as EN IEC 61800-9-2:2025/A1:2026.

The following dates are fixed:

- latest date by which the document has to be implemented at national (top) 2027-02-28 level by publication of an identical national standard or by endorsement
- latest date by which the national standards conflicting with the (down) 2029-02-28 document have to be withdrawn

Attention is drawn to the possibility that some of the elements of this document may be the subject of patent rights. CENELEC shall not be held responsible for identifying any or all such patent rights.

Any feedback and questions on this document should be directed to the users' national committee. A complete listing of these bodies can be found on the CENELEC website.

Endorsement notice

The text of the International Standard IEC 61800-9-2:2023/AMD1:2025 was approved by CENELEC as a European Standard without any modification.

The overall base ejector method has the advantages of large diameter flow rate and an open device structure. Its disadvantages are: a large mechanical stress of the ejector rod body; the fixed base engine generally cannot adapt to large altitude or large flood atmospheres; and higher requirements for the base pump for high draft gas pressure.

According to the data in (8), the base flow velocity in the DO sistem system was as high as \(1.5 \mathrm{~m/s}\), and the base pump flow velocity and base-pump system in Figure $2$ reached Mpa.
